They have consistently held the top spot or been in the top two since the survey's inception in 1990, according to Oncology News Central.

related_questions.question: Is MD Anderson the best cancer center in the world?

text_blocks.snippet: While "best" is subjective, the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center is widely recognized as one of the top cancer centers in the world. It consistently ranks highly in national and international surveys and is known for its research, clinical trials, and comprehensive cancer care.
snippet_highlighted_words: the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center is widely recognized as one of the top cancer centers in the world

text_blocks.snippet: Here's why MD Anderson is considered a top cancer center:

list.title: Rankings:
list.snippet: MD Anderson frequently tops the "Best Hospitals" rankings by U.S. News & World Report.

list.title: Comprehensive Care:
list.snippet: MD Anderson offers a wide range of cancer treatments and services, including surgery, radiation therapy, chemotherapy, and innovative therapies.

list.title: Research and Innovation:
list.snippet: MD Anderson Cancer Center is a leader in cancer research, with extensive clinical trials and a focus on developing new treatments.

list.title: Clinical Trials:
list.snippet: MD Anderson runs the world's largest cancer clinical trials program, offering patients access to cutting-edge therapies.

list.title: Specialized Expertise:
list.snippet: MD Anderson sees and treats a high volume of rare and complex cancers, providing expertise that many other centers may not have.

list.title: Training and Education:
list.snippet: MD Anderson is committed to training the next generation of cancer experts.

list.title: Commitment to Ending Cancer:
list.snippet: MD Anderson Cancer Center has a mission to make cancer history and is actively involved in cancer prevention and research efforts.
